table_identity.source: value_framework_config.yaml p_bucket_given_fv_{hitter,pitcher}: five published CONSENSUS-FV cells per side (45, 45+ axis 47.5, 50, 55, 60)
table_identity.note: every served probability outside that support is an extrapolation

arms.CAL: INC through a nested forward-chained Platt map (baseline, not re-litigated)
arms.CONST: flat constant at the WITHIN-CUT base rate of prior folds
arms.QWAR: same quantile construction on pure model WAR instead of rank_war
arms.NAT: p_bucket_given_fv(consensus_fv_raw)[bust] - the table at its NATIVE index
arms.QNT_P: QNT through the same nested forward-chained Platt map

sign_convention: d = metric(baseline) - metric(candidate); POSITIVE means the CANDIDATE is better.
ship_criterion: QNT ships only if it beats CONST on Brier AND log loss, on pooled AND pooled_served, with the paired refit bootstrap CI95 excluding zero on all four; plus the level-shift trap and the permutation rule.

frame.test_restriction: censored is False, target_resolved numeric, consensus_fv_raw present
